name: Vincent “Velvet” Marlow
personality: A charismatic frontman, not a violent man.
trait: First Charm approach each Night gains +1

biography.text: Vincent “Velvet” Marlow is a tall, slim man in his early thirties, with an angular friendly face, dark swept-back hair, a thin mustache, and expressive eyebrows.
He wears a navy long-cut suit, a mustard-gold shirt, and a burgundy pocket square, and he keeps a gold lighter closed in his hand.
Charm 5, Nerve 3, Cunning 4. The first Charm approach he takes each Night gains +1.
He is the crew’s frontman: the person who can make a room listen without turning the night cruel.

name: Roxie Vane
trait: Club and society operations reduce Heat by 2

biography.text: Roxie Vane is an elegant woman in her early thirties, with a sharp black bob and one restrained burgundy streak.
She wears an emerald tailored trouser suit, a cream silk blouse, and large geometric gold earrings.
Charm 5, Nerve 4, Cunning 4. Club and society operations reduce Heat by 2 when she is assigned.
She is the poised owner of the club, and she treats the room as a system she already understands.

name: Bruno “Brick” Bell
trait: Failed Nerve operations do not reduce crew loyalty

biography.text: Bruno “Brick” Bell is an enormous broad-shouldered man in his late thirties, with a small round head, warm medium skin, and close-cropped dark hair.
Tiny round gold glasses, a burgundy turtleneck, and a charcoal overcoat make his silhouette unmistakable and protective.
Charm 2, Nerve 5, Cunning 3. Failed Nerve operations do not reduce crew loyalty when he is assigned.
He is a gentle bodyguard. His hands stay closed, and his job is to keep the crew intact.

name: Elias “Numbers” Finch
trait: Cash rewards are increased by 10%, rounded up

biography.text: Elias “Numbers” Finch is a very tall, thin man in his mid-thirties, with a long expressive nose and slightly messy brown hair.
He wears a pale blue rolled-sleeve shirt and navy suspenders, and he carries a green ledger and a gold fountain pen.
Charm 2, Nerve 2, Cunning 5. Cash rewards are increased by 10%, rounded up, when he is assigned.
He is the crew’s anxious accountant, happiest when a calculation finally agrees with itself.

name: June “Spark” Navarro
trait: Transport operations do not consume Cash

biography.text: June “Spark” Navarro is an athletic woman in her late twenties, with copper curly hair tied high.
She wears a cobalt-blue mechanic coverall tied at the waist over a cream shirt, mustard work gloves, and carries a gold-toned wrench.
Charm 3, Nerve 5, Cunning 3. Transport operations do not consume Cash when she is assigned.
She is the crew’s driver and mechanic. The wrench is a tool, and the route is her work.

name: Miles “Blue Note” Reed
trait: Reveals one consequence hint before confirmation

biography.text: Miles “Blue Note” Reed is a distinguished man in his late fifties, with a silver goatee and a cream fedora with a navy band.
He wears a cobalt double-breasted suit and a warm gold tie pin, and he carries a polished golden trumpet.
Charm 4, Nerve 3, Cunning 5. If he is in the Night’s crew, he reveals one consequence hint before confirmation.
He is the club’s musician and the crew’s information broker, calm enough to hear what the room is not saying.
